mapper.insert: insert into crawl_runs (started_at, threads, requests_per_second, max_pages, max_retries, retry_backoff_millis, circuit_breaker_threshold, attempted_pages, news_stored, dropped_links, remaining_pages, consecutive_blocks) values (#{startedAt}, #{threads}, #{requestsPerSecond}, #{maxPages}, #{maxRetries}, #{retryBackoffMillis}, #{circuitBreakerThreshold}, #{attemptedPages}, #{newsStored}, #{droppedLinks}, #{remainingPages}, #{consecutiveBlocks})
mapper.update: update crawl_runs set finished_at = #{finishedAt}, attempted_pages = #{attemptedPages}, news_stored = #{newsStored}, dropped_links = #{droppedLinks}, remaining_pages = #{remainingPages}, consecutive_blocks = #{consecutiveBlocks}, stop_reason = #{stopReason} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from crawl_runs order by id desc limit #{limit}
